email.subject: AI for McGrail & Bensinger, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi David,

Your National Tier 2 ranking in Bankruptcy and Creditor Debtor Rights speaks to McGrail & Bensinger's deep expertise in complex restructuring work. That's exactly where AI adds the most value: handling document review, timeline analysis, and stakeholder communication so your team stays focused on strategy.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office this week to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
